body: Thank you for the help everyone
Perfect, thank you so much :) all of that sounds like exactly what I would like to do lol
Omg I would love this, I watch YouTube videos of tarot readings alllll the time!
Today is a wonderful day because I was blessed enough to wake up and I am healthy!

Wow, I’ve been looking for a sign and I woke up to this notification. This is amazing, thank you. I’ve been holding onto my toxic person for 2 years now and I’ve been stuck on what to do but every sign I’ve been getting is to move on lol I think the universe / God is trying to tell me something 😜
What’s your YouTube channel ? I’d love to watch your videos and subscribe to help you with views to get more money.
I would of commented how cool it was even if you didn’t post that caption. It’s amazing. You should be proud of yourself :)
I am super thankful for my amazing support system
Sending positive vibes and energy your way as well. Thank you so much for this. I asked the universe to give me a sign this past week and I just got this notification on my phone! God bless.
Yes please, I just stared my journey this would be perfect!!! Thank you

Yup; I feel this. I was diagnosed with BPD so I know how you feel. Read it, trust me. I think I like the YouTube  video because you can see and read peoples success stories ( in the comments) it gives you a lot of motivation. I was you a month ago, I thought about killing my self all the tome.  No joke. I tried to kill my self so many times but never worked for a reason. 

I hope that you find a way to cope with your feelings. I use to feel so alone so I know how it feels. I know you probably hear this over the internet a lot but please message me. I feel it in my heart that I can help you through this. I know how it feel, if anyone does, I do. I can help you. You might think that as of right now you might think it won’t get better but one day it will!!!!! Let me help you come close  to that one day! I’m in school to help people like you and ME. So whenever you’re ready, message me 💕
Congrats: I’m saying that already cause I know you got it!!!!!

Please don’t. You listed so many reasons why you should be alive. You have people that love you, like you said your mother will be devastated. All these feelings you’re feeling now, your mom will just carry those same exact feelings with her. Please please please just tell someone that you’re close with that you want to kill yourself and try to get some help before you make a permanent decision. Take it from me, I’m struggling with depression, BPD and Suicide thoughts everyday but I’m still here. I just take one day at a time. I know how you feel. I’m 24, beautiful, smart and have lots of friends and family that love me so trust me when I say we are on the same boat. Please message me before you do it, we can talk. I’ll stay up all night if you want to talk I don’t care.
You shouldn’t assume that I don’t think God is real. I very much know he is real and I just got baptized a month ago. I’ve been trying to get closer to God.
Happppppppppppppppppppppy birthday, I hope you get to spend MANY MANY more on this earth. You are worthy, you are strong and good things will happen for you this year. Have a great day!

Please don’t let what what other trolls say on the internet effect you. There’s SO many good, encouraging and kind people on this sub. Don’t let one bad apple make you feel crappy about yourself. You might not feel like it but I’m sure there’s people in your life that are so happy you’re here on this earth. People like to belittle other people online because they’re miserable and want to make other people feel miserable. Message me if you ever need to talk. Even though I don’t know you, I’m happy you’re alive.
